WEBSITE PRIVACY / 17 SEPTEMBER 2026

A little clarity.

This page covers the Kokonut website. It does not replace privacy information for SideQuest, Macrova or Revisen, which have their own accounts, storage and services.

Browsing this website

The website code does not use analytics, advertising trackers, sign-up forms, cookies or local storage. It does not request your location, camera, microphone or contacts.

The hosting and network providers may process ordinary technical request information, including IP addresses, requested URLs and browser information, to serve and protect the website. Website fonts and images are served with the site.

Downloading an app

APK download buttons take you to files hosted by GitHub. GitHub processes the download request under its own privacy terms. A GitHub account is not required to download a public APK.

Downloading an APK does not create an account in any of our apps. When you open an app, its own permissions, account requirements and data handling apply. Read its test notes before using it.

Your device

The website checks your browser’s device information locally to show installation guidance for iPhone and iPad visitors. That check is not sent to an analytics service. The checksum copy button writes to your clipboard only when you press it.
